Definition: Kerioth, the name of two places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Kerioth is the name of two places: one a town of Judah listed among her cities, the other a city of Moab under judgment in Jeremiah and Amos. The same name sits in a list of inheritance and in a list of fire.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a name can hold both promise and judgment, and which one Kerioth hears depends on whose people dwell there.
